blocks.text: Each teacher global view supervises different student views; aligned views are excluded. The task is: Compute original-DINO cross-view loss. Student logits are [V,B,K], V>=2; detached teacher probabilities are [2,B,K]. Exclude student/teacher pairs (0,0) and (1,1), average over examples and remaining pairs, and return (loss,pair_count).

The inputs are `student`, `teacher_targets`, `temperature`. Keep their roles separate while you trace the solution. The animation follows the supplied implementation, so every highlighted operation connects to code you can inspect.

What changes in the boundary case

Change one input at the edge of the stated contract and trace where the behavior changes. Use the Trace control to switch between the normal path and this boundary focus. The algorithm does not get permission to invent an unstated fallback.

A useful test changes one condition while holding the remaining inputs fixed. Compare the output shape, state transition, valid edges, selected tokens, or returned status. This isolates the reason for the change.
